title: Native launcher depends on UNC current directory for worktree builds
body: To configure the assigned WSL worktree natively I had to pass -S with the UNC source directory and pass the preset-derived binary directory explicitly to the background build job. cmd.exe must stay on a drvfs cwd, while CMake 4.2 build presets resolve their file from the child job cwd. Consolidate path-aware source and binary roots in the native preset/launcher so each lane does not wire them by hand.

title: WSL provisioning needs Windows command discovery from SSH shells
body: The queued command cmd.exe /c build.bat provision failed with cmd.exe: command not found because the SSH environment omits Windows System32 from PATH. I retried using /mnt/c/Windows/System32/cmd.exe, and provisioning then reached its elevation stop. Fold Windows command discovery or path translation into the existing build.bat invocation so lanes do not need a machine-specific manual path.

title: External Vulkan SDK loader lookup misses LunarG's nested Linux loader
body: The queued configure command with VULKAN_SDK pointing at LunarG 1.4.350.1 and VIXEN_VULKAN_SDK_VERSION=1.4.350.0 failed because FindVulkan found the headers but left Vulkan_LIBRARY-NOTFOUND; this SDK stores libvulkan.so under lib/VulkanLoader/lib. I moved the existing loader-path lookup ahead of the initial package lookup, after which configure accepted the patch variation and validated the tools. Consolidate loader layout discovery for externally selected SDK roots in the provisioning facade.
